honesty.evidence: 2. **Convolutional Layer**: This is the core layer of a CNN. It applies a set of learnable filters (also called kernels) to the input image. Each filter is a small matrix that slides over the input image, performing element-wise multiplication and summing the results to produce a 2D activation map. This process is repeated for each filter, resulting in a set of feature maps. The number of feature maps is equal to the number of filters used.
